contextBlocks.aiSummary: Opening table setup and historical framing; the DM explicitly sets the current date to January 22 before play begins.

dateValidation.reason: The DM explicitly sets the current date to January 22, 1730, whereas both YAML endpoints are January 25. Continuous afternoon play and a credited short rest do not account for three days.

findings.reason: The DM says it is now January 22 after narrating January 8, 1730. YAML drStart and drEnd both give 1730-01-25. Neither speech nor YAML is corrected here.
The DM credits a short rest for time already spent talking. This is continuous play at the same platform rather than a newly narrated time skip, so it remains one scene.
